integrity: Exact all-graph claim rests on an explicit orthogonal energy decomposition and Foster trace identity; finite exact-rational tests are corroborative, not proof. Bibliographic searches cannot establish absolute novelty.
scientific_limitations: Only finite connected simple vertex-transitive unit-edge metric graphs, with trivial common-length scaling, real continuous edgewise H1 functions, arclength zero mean, and derivative-energy endpoint norms. No unequal edge-length or weighted-mean extension; an implicit older equivalent may exist.
title: Resistance-minimal edge midpoints and sharp Sobolev evaluation on vertex-transitive metric graphs
